title: FHIR Validation Requirements
description: FHIR Implementation Guide content must pass SUSHI compilation, IG Publisher QA, and conformance validation.

statements.label: SUSHI compilation succeeds
statements.requirement: All FSH files SHALL compile successfully with SUSHI before IG Publisher build.

successCriteria.criterion: SUSHI compilation finishes with zero fatal errors and zero regular errors.

statements.label: IG Publisher QA passes
statements.requirement: The IG Publisher build SHALL complete with no errors in qa.html.

successCriteria.criterion: Generated qa.html from the IG Publisher build contains zero reported errors.

statements.label: CRMI profile conformance
statements.requirement: Resources SHOULD conform to CRMI profiles (Shareable, Publishable, Computable, Executable) as applicable.

successCriteria.criterion: Resource definitions declare and validate conformance against applicable CRMI profile schemas.

statements.label: Terminology bindings valid
statements.requirement: All terminology bindings SHALL reference valid ValueSets with resolvable codes.

successCriteria.criterion: All coded elements in FHIR resources resolve against valid, published ValueSet definitions.
